missions.title: Absent
missions.description: "Ange's actions would inevitably have consequences. That's just who she is."

missions.title: An Arrow in Flight II
missions.description: "Here, all hesitation must be eradicated; no amount of cowardice will help."

missions.title: An Arrow in Flight II
missions.description: "Those who find even the slimmest ray of sunlight blinding may be more accepting of a life deprived of the sun from the very start."

missions.title: Torricelli's Trumpet I
missions.description: "I am the light of the world; he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life."

missions.title: Torricelli's Trumpet II
missions.description: "If the society doesn't uproot its problems, nothing will ever be resolved."

missions.title: Torricelli's Trumpet III
missions.description: "Salvation lies within."

missions.title: Athena's Owl
missions.description: "He's young, brave, brilliant, and has aspirations... almost like replica of her."

missions.title: Selene's Dream
missions.description: "Days go by, the world decays, and even fond memory slowly fades."

missions.title: The Way of What is To come
missions.description: "Paradeus combat simulation will commence shortly. Relevant personnel, please attend the pre-battle briefing."

missions.title: Survival Guide
missions.description: "In conclusion, Squad Puzzle is not suited to fighting as a team. +End of record compilation."

missions.title: Wrestling Snakes I
missions.description: "One does not fall for the same trap twice."

missions.title: Wrestling Snakes II
missions.description: "You are the third kind, the one that knows what they're fighting for, Commander."

missions.title: The Birth of Apate I
missions.description: "Elsa's voice blends into the cheers of the refugees and the whole world became a sea of joy."

missions.title: The Birth of Apate II
missions.description: "At the time, I had yet to grasp what was hidden under her demonic facade."

missions.title: Lurking
missions.description: "All who believe in the Lord shall receive happiness and peace. All who defy Him shall suffer disaster and judgment."

missions.title: Hemera Points to the Light I
missions.description: "White devils and the envoy chasing after them."

missions.title: Hemera Points to the Light II
missions.description: "Heroes in black turn their back on the distant purgatory."

missions.title: Hemera Points to the Light III
missions.description: "It is imprinted with the image of a mighty griffin baring its claws, surrounded by intricate designs."

missions.title: Shoulders of a Griffin I
missions.description: "Its exterior is mottled from the passage of long years, but its classical proportions are still enough to make one stop to marvel at it."

missions.title: Shoulders of a Griffin III
missions.description: "Everything we do is for the future of ourselves and this world."

missions.title: Ship of Theseus I
missions.description: "All happy people are alike; each unhappy person is unhappy in their own way."

missions.title: Ship of Theseus II
missions.description: "It's inevitable to be lost in life, but don't ever end up at the wrong destination."

missions.title: Ship of Theseus III
missions.description: "If the planks of the ship of Theseus were constantly being changed out, until none of the planks were the original ones, then would it still be the original ship?"

missions.title: Balls and Vase
missions.description: "In this foreign land, the only person she could trust is me."

missions.title: Cretan Liar
missions.description: "Maybe one day we'll stand side by side, fighting for the same goal."

missions.title: Reflection
missions.description: "Do not trust the glamourous facade; the only thing we can trust is ourselves."

missions.title: Cracks
missions.description: "If we can't find mutual understanding... then I will be very sorry."

missions.title: Ariadne's Clew I
missions.description: "With a Virtual Cognition Image of hers, it's clear that she's 100% a Nyto."

missions.title: Ariadne's Clew III
missions.description: "Two small insects both fall into a tiny pit, awaiting the coming storm."

missions.title: Heraclitus' River I
missions.description: "If I can deliver a dirty bomb straight into the prime minister's office, then what else is off-limits to me?"

missions.title: Heraclitus' River II
missions.description: "I'll make them an offer they can't refuse."

missions.title: Heraclitus' River III
missions.description: "If he's setting up a game of chess, then I'll just ruin his board."

missions.title: The Grain of Millet I
missions.description: "When you gaze into the abyss, you are already within it."

missions.title: The Grain of Millet II
missions.description: "Butterflies aren't the only thing coming out of a cocoon."

missions.title: The Grain of Millet III
missions.description: "Don't play with Pandora's box."

missions.title: Night Festival
missions.description: "Festivals, they tend to start at midnight."

missions.title: Cretan Labyrinth I
missions.description: "We all have a shared goal of averting disaster and making this world a better place."

missions.title: Cretan Labyrinth II
missions.description: "A first acquaintance lends to the truest of peace of minds."

missions.title: Cretan Labyrinth III
missions.description: "Only blood can heal the wounds."

missions.title: The Indecipherable Heart
missions.description: "What should I say to everyone at the base?"

missions.title: The Prisoner's Dilemma I
missions.description: "Although we are called "Defy", we will never betray you."

missions.title: The Prisoner's Dilemma III
missions.description: "There are no bio signs in the building. I'm not detecting AK-12's signal either."

missions.title: Flash
missions.description: "I understand and respect his decision... We're family. I will always support him."

missions.title: Dreams on the Island of Dia I
missions.description: "I want 10 instances of immunity. When I invoke them, you cannot attack me for my words."

missions.title: Dreams on the Island of Dia II
missions.description: "Memories dictate one's consciousness, yet the consciousness can hardly recall all the memories."

missions.title: Dreams on the Island of Dia III
missions.description: "Take a good look at your face, because you don't know when you're going to lose it."

missions.title: Dreams on the Island of Dia IV
missions.description: "I hope that on my triumphant return, I can still see those who are waiting for me."

missions.title: Cratylus' River I
missions.description: "Would you rather do something great in a brave new world or toil away for some dwindling flame in the old world?"

missions.title: Cratylus' River III
missions.description: "The vortex rips through all caught in its center with no exceptions."

missions.title: Defying the Moerae I
missions.description: "There are many pointless things in the world. Putting up a fight will never be one of them."

missions.title: Defying the Moerae III
missions.description: "When you discover a bomb, best make sure there isn't another one around.

missions.title: Clotho's Thread I
missions.description: "The duty of the gardener is to prune the rotten fruit away."

missions.title: Clotho's Thread II
missions.description: "Nothing's invincible in this world. It's with that belief that I've triumphed until now."

missions.title: Clotho's Thread III
missions.description: "Just remember—any place where I am is reality."

missions.title: Achilles and the Tortoise I
missions.description: "I am the way I am, not because of mere thoughts or programming, but because of something far more valuable."

missions.title: Achilles and the Tortoise III
missions.description: "Moths dance around the light, casting fluttery shadows on the tragically beautiful corpse."

missions.title: Lachesis' Measure I
missions.description: "Returning to old ground is not necessarily a good thing sometimes."

missions.title: Lachesis' Measure II
missions.description: "The tragedy of all fanatics, is that they truly believe in their own salvation."

missions.title: Lachesis' Measure III
missions.description: "She laughed as she cried, only to eventually shut her mouth, her voice becoming incredibly tiny."

missions.title: Atropos' Shears I
missions.description: "Running away from problems comes with a price that is too heavy to pay."

missions.title: Atropos' Shears III
missions.description: "Our effort to alter fate is futile, but at least it won't befall today."

missions.title: Zeno's Circle of Knowledge
missions.description: "AK12, at your service."

missions.title: Schrödinger’s Cat
missions.description: "No matter how many fall before them, they will rise to carry on; this the nature of a hero."

missions.title: Remembrance
missions.description: "Time leaves its mark in everyone's memory, but years later, only remembrance remains."

missions.title: Pandora's Box I
missions.description: "Does hope truly lie at the bottom of Pandora's Box?"

missions.title: Pandora's Box III
missions.description: "Only the moth knows how fascinating the flames truly are."

missions.title: Brain in a Vat I
missions.description: "I do not fear death, I'm just afraid Sister will be sad."

missions.title: Brain in a Vat III
missions.description: "He collapses onto the floor like a ragdoll, and Ange's shattered heart falls along with him."

missions.title: Möbius Strip
missions.description: "See you in the brave new world."

missions.title: Nyx's Night I
missions.description: "The most agonizing of dreams are often rooted in reality."

missions.title: Nyx's Night II
missions.description: "I have a the heartbeat of a human being, thus proving that I am not a monster."

missions.title: Nyx's Night IV
missions.description: "Classics never go out of style."

missions.title: Hypnos' Eyes I
missions.description: "Sweet dreams, stranger."

missions.title: Hypnos' Eyes III
missions.description: "The fallen spirit chants; the walking living fights."

missions.title: Thanatos' Kiss I
missions.description: "Now, it's time to unshackle the mad hound."

missions.title: Thanatos' Kiss III
missions.description: "Dirge of the Griffin."

missions.title: Chaos' Abyss I
missions.description: "...Thank you, Robin."

missions.title: Chaos' Abyss II
missions.description: "Despair birthed at the moment of hope's demise is often the most delightful."

missions.title: Chaos' Abyss III
missions.description: "Nobody's sacrifice is without value because by relinquishing their lives, they will be giving the living something even more precious."

missions.title: Dreams on the Island of Dia II - EX
